content.value: Make sentences using the following modals as directed. i) May (To express guess about the future) ii) Must (To express logical deduction in the present) jii) Need (To express unnecessary action in the past) iv) Should (To express duty in the past) v) Could (To express polite request) vi) Be to (To express command) vii) Be going to (To express strong possibility)
